# Rachel Fletcher — rachelfletcherwrites.com

> Rachel Fletcher writes folkloric fiction and personal essays from the Shenandoah Valley of Virginia. Her forthcoming novel is *The Flower Farm at the End of the World*. Her letters publish on Substack as **Fletchling Thoughts** ("Learning to be a meaning maker in a world of already but not yet").

## Pages

- [Home](https://rachelfletcherwrites.com/): who Rachel is, the novel teaser, and where to follow along
- [Recipes](https://rachelfletcherwrites.com/recipes): index of the seasonal, from-scratch recipes from the letters
- [About](https://rachelfletcherwrites.com/about): bio and background
- [Free Guides](https://rachelfletcherwrites.com/guides): index of all free guides
- [Reading List](https://rachelfletcherwrites.com/reading-list): free printable PDF, "12 Books to Read With Your Middle Schooler", in exchange for an email address
- [How to Read a Yarn Band](https://rachelfletcherwrites.com/how-to-read-a-yarn-band): free beginner's guide to everything printed on a yarn label — fibre, weight, needle size, gauge, care symbols, dye lot
- [Navigating the Yarn Aisle](https://rachelfletcherwrites.com/navigating-the-yarn-aisle): free beginner's field guide to buying your first yarn and needles
- Both yarn pages offer "Learn to Knit an Heirloom Wardrobe", a free 26-page beginner knitting guide, in exchange for an email address

## Elsewhere

- [Fletchling Thoughts on Substack](https://rachelfletcher.substack.com/): the letters — essays, recipes, and fiction
- [Pinterest](https://www.pinterest.com/rachelfletcherwrites/): visual boards for the kitchen, the valley, and the novel's world
